description:
Because:
- The nest-typed-config/class-validator resolution held class-validator at 0.14.1.
- From 0.14.2, validate() without options rejects classes that have no decorators.

This commit:
- Removes the resolution and moves root class-validator to ^0.15.1.
- Adds top-level decorators to GetExperimentsActionResult and GetCMSChurnInterventionActionResult.
- Adds NextIOValidator specs for both result classes.

Closes FXA-11987
